applied.quote: You can contest a charge above the protected amount, and a bill that matches your EOB Patient Balance is the amount CMS says you owe after your insurer pays.
applied.replacement: If the bill is higher than your EOB Patient Balance, CMS says to talk to your provider, and a bill that matches your EOB Patient Balance is the amount CMS says you owe after your insurer pays.
applied.why: No 'protected amount' for planned care; CMS says talk to provider if higher

applied.quote: If the bill matches the Patient Balance, the federal protection has done its work, and the remaining amount is the share your plan assigned to you.
applied.replacement: If the bill matches the Patient Balance, it is the amount CMS says you owe after your insurer has paid everything else.
applied.why: CMS only defines Patient Balance as amount owed after insurer pays
